result:
QA-29115 is PASS. Reactions + Comments + Shares equals Engagements on every post I could check.

- **What I checked:** The UCLA LinkedIn grid for Jan 01 – Oct 01, 2025 shows 1,013 posts, but Table View renders only 200 at a time. I checked the top 200 by Engagements (200/200 matched) and, after sorting ascending, the bottom 200 (200/200 matched).
- **Totals row:** The Sum row, which covers all 1,013 posts, also matches: 133,014 + 4,270 + 7,147 = 144,431.
- **Not checked:** The 613 mid-range posts can't be shown in any single view, so I didn't check them individually.
- **Brand:** Typing "UCLA" in the brand search returned only sub-brands, not a brand named exactly "UCLA". I used "University of California, Los Angeles", the account's main brand, as earlier runs did.
- **Bugs:** None open and none reproduced. The numbers are identical to the 2026-10-27 run.

The report is at `results/2026-10-28/QA-29115-report.md`, and screenshots are under `.playwright-out/QA-29115/`. I did no skill or REGISTRY maintenance, as instructed.
